name: The sitting room at 221B
description: A crowded first-floor room: two armchairs by the fire, a table spread with papers and chemicals, a cello by the window seat, a bust of a statesman gone grey with dust.

features.name: The fire
features.description: A coal fire that Mrs Hudson keeps going from seven.

features.name: The table
features.description: Papers, a microscope and the remains of breakfast.
